# rhcs_external_auth_provider (Resource)

Manages an external authentication provider on a ready ROSA HCP cluster. The cluster must be created with external authentication enabled. OCM permits one external authentication provider per cluster, and a newly created provider can take a few minutes to become effective. `issuer_ca` contains PEM certificate content, such as `file("ca.pem")`, not a file path. `console_extra_scopes` applies to the console client; no `profile` scope is added implicitly.

For readable optional attributes, omission or `null` preserves the API value and records it in state. Explicitly configured values are reconciled with the API. The console client secret is not computed because the API does not return it; configure it together with the console client ID, and configure scopes only when both client fields are set. Use an empty string or empty list/set to clear supported values. Set both console client fields to empty strings to remove the console client.

Import with `<cluster_id>,<name>`. Import refreshes readable optional attributes from the API. The console client's secret cannot be recovered and remains null in state. Set `console_client_secret` in configuration before updating a confidential console client. Updates to the console client fail safely if the provider also has clients for other components, because their secrets cannot be preserved reliably in a replacement client list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cluster_id" {
  description = "ID of a ready ROSA HCP cluster with external authentication enabled."
  type        = string
}

variable "console_client_id" {
  description = "OIDC client ID registered for the OpenShift console."
  type        = string
}

variable "console_client_secret" {
  description = "OIDC client secret for the OpenShift console."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "issuer_url" {
  description = "HTTPS URL of the OIDC token issuer."
  type        = string
}

resource "rhcs_external_auth_provider" "main" {
  cluster          = var.cluster_id
  name             = "example"
  issuer_url       = var.issuer_url
  issuer_audiences = [var.console_client_id]
  # Optional: provide PEM certificate content when the issuer uses a private CA.
  # issuer_ca = file("ca.pem")
  console_client_id     = var.console_client_id
  console_client_secret = var.console_client_secret
  # Request only if this identity provider requires the profile scope.
  console_extra_scopes = ["profile"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) ID of the ROSA HCP cluster. The cluster must have external authentication enabled.
- `issuer_audiences` (Set of String) Audiences for which tokens from the issuer are valid (one to ten values).
- `issuer_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the token issuer.
- `name` (String) Name of the external authentication provider; used as its OCM ID.

### Optional

- `claim_mapping_groups_claim` (String) ID token claim used to map groups. Set an empty string to clear it; When omitted, the current API value is recorded in state.
- `claim_mapping_username_claim` (String) ID token claim used to construct usernames. Set an empty string to clear it; When omitted, the current API value is recorded in state.
- `claim_validation_rule` (List of String) Rules for token claims in claim:required_value format. The first colon separates the claim; later colons belong to required_value. Set an empty list to clear rules. When omitted, the current API value is recorded in state.
- `console_client_id` (String) Client ID used by the OpenShift console. Must be set with console_client_secret and appear in issuer_audiences. Set both client fields to empty strings to remove the client; When omitted, the current API client ID is recorded in state.
- `console_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret for the OpenShift console application. Must be set with console_client_id. The API requires a non-empty secret for an existing console client; set both client fields empty to remove it. The API does not return the secret; import leaves it null in state.
- `console_extra_scopes` (Set of String) Additional scopes requested by the OpenShift console client. Requires console_client_id and console_client_secret when configured. When omitted, API scopes are recorded in state; an empty set clears them.
- `issuer_ca` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate bundle content for the issuer (for example, file("ca.pem")). Set an empty string to clear it; When omitted, the current API value is recorded in state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the external authentication provider.
